title: Accept current P007 global pressure-shell T07A screen
scope: K01-P-007 global +0.20 bar static and -0.20 bar linear buckling only
decision: Accept T07A global pressure-shell evidence on current frozen C2R1 geometry. Do not require another mesh-refinement iteration for this global screen. Keep local J2 contact/seal/preload/thread/galling/leak/service qualification outside T07A.

sanity_checks: 3.1229 N reaction at 0.02 MPa corresponds to 156.145 mm2 projected area / 14.100 mm equivalent diameter
current lambda1 differs from historical comparison by about 1.86%
reported mesh contains no distorted elements

mesh_convergence.reason: Margins to the project screening criteria are about 138x for static strength and 192x for linear buckling; pressure reaction is geometrically reconciled and the current buckling result closely reproduces independent historical evidence. Additional refinement is not decision-changing for the present global screen.

stale_triggers: P007 geometry or wall thickness change
